compatibility.wireIdentifiers: Original profile URI, github-issue-comment/1, mapping revision 1 and core 0.1.0-draft.1 remain unchanged.

compatibility.profileDigest: Descriptions still hash the complete original profile.json, not this sidecar or the README. Component byte hashes are additional archival pins.
compatibility.candidateIdentity: This candidate ID identifies a frozen sidecar only. Changed semantics or components require a new revision, never reassignment of an old identifier.

failureSemantics.precedence: Preserve the original profile and selected consumer contract. This sidecar adds no description-processing stage and changes no failure precedence.
